# Garage2Home (G2H)

> Garage2Home (G2H), run by Garage2Home LLP, is a startup based in Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, India, bringing mobility to garage services. It brings essential garage services to the customer's doorstep: home, workplace or farm. Launching soon.

- Website: https://garage2home.in/
- Contact: support@garage2home.in
- Tagline: Your garage, at your doorstep.

## Pages
- [Home](https://garage2home.in/): launch announcement and contact
- [About Us](https://garage2home.in/about-us/): who we are, what we do, the problem we solve, what is innovative, how we are different

## Services
- Windshield replacement
- Battery replacement
- Wiper replacement
- Headlight restoration
- New headlight fitting

## How G2H is different
G2H drives the garage to the customer's doorstep instead of the customer driving to the garage. Authorized service centres are reliable but inconvenient and selective; local garages are cheaper but compromise on quality, warranty and service experience. G2H bridges that gap.
